items.rationale: Accept easy. Ștecher, Prelungitor electric and Cablu electric connect appliances to electrical power; Robinet controls water. The inliers include a part, a cable and a complete extension device, but all satisfy the stated functional predicate without a category switch. The four words are familiar household hardware; choosing by water versus electricity requires the intended meaning, not a person/object type shortcut. No alternative trio has an equally precise ordinary shared function. Three words are new in this game; maximum old-board overlap is one.

Accept easy. Foame, Sete and Oboseală signal ordinary bodily needs for food, water and rest, while Rușine names a social emotion. All four are states, so the odd word cannot be found by grammatical or KG type alone. Emotional and figurative uses do not yield a competing three-word physiological group in the everyday senses. This introduces three unused Intrusul words and no reused inlier trio. The statement is a language association, not a diagnostic or health instruction.

Accept easy. Bunică, Bunic and Mătușă name relatives, whereas Coleg names a shared school or work relationship. A particular colleague may also be a relative, but that overlap between people does not change the words’ definitions. All four name interpersonal roles, making the kinship criterion exact and recognizable. Gender does not create a competing trio: two female and two male forms are shown. All four visible concepts are new in Intrusul.

Accept normal. Ochi–A vedea, Dormitor–Pat and Detergent–Burete de vase provide immediate bodily, room/furniture and cleaning anchors. Stela Popescu–Alexandru Arșinel is a recognizable Romanian comedy partnership, not merely two arbitrary actors. Eye/bed sleep associations cannot complete another matching, because Dormitor then has no plausible connection to A vedea. Neither comic actor fits another displayed member better. All four intended pairs are absent from the current Perechi inventory; exact graph gates support rather than replace this semantic judgment.

Accept normal. Ureche–A auzi, Cablu electric–Prelungitor electric, Vapor–Port and Scrisoarea III–Mihai Eminescu each have a nameable function, part/device, transport destination or authorship relation. The displayed electrical qualifier rules out cable as an unrelated rope, and the maritime Port snapshot is consistent with the ship. Hearing a poem is possible but leaves Ureche and Mihai Eminescu without an equally definite alternative pairing. The four intended pairs are new, without strong on-board cross edges.

Accept normal. Curcubeu–Culoare and Calendar–Zi are accessible anchors, followed by Castelul Peleș–Sinaia and Făină–Cozonac. The castle/city connection and the culinary ingredient/preparation link are specific and familiar. Rainbow/day weather co-occurrence does not give a second complete matching: Calendar and Culoare would then have only a generic visual association. All twelve intended associations across the three Perechi boards are new; this board’s four links do not depend on hidden descriptions to become guessable.
